Definition: a potsherd, i.e. (by implication) a pottery; the name of a gate at Jerusalem
BiblicalUsage: Charcuth is a potsherd, and it names a gate: Jeremiah is sent to the valley of Hinnom by the entry of the east gate, the potsherd gate, to proclaim the words God will tell him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gate's name fits the message: a broken potsherd of a city, proclaimed at a gate named for broken pots.
RelatedEvents: Jeremiah Breaks the Flask at Topheth
